title: Tolkovo realtime: server → widget message
description: One JSON text frame from the widget's realtime connection (GET /api/v1/widget/realtime). The widget opens it with the subprotocols ["tolkovo.widget.v1", <session token>] and sends nothing over it: messages, receipts and session changes go over REST. Every message is {type, id, ts, data}; there is no seq and no replay: after hello, resync_required or a reconnect the widget refetches its chat over REST (GET /widget/messages with its cursor). data holds ids only, never texts. A new field in data is not a breaking change; removing or renaming one is.

messageType.description: Every message type of the widget connection.

closeCode.description: WebSocket close codes. 1008: the widget sent a frame, do not retry without a fix. 1011: internal error, reconnect with backoff. 1012: server restart, reconnect with jitter. 4401: the session ended (expired, ended, the widget was disconnected or no longer allows this page), start a new session over REST. 4408: slow consumer, reconnect and refetch. 4429: too many connections of this session, reconnect only after a long backoff.

ts.description: RFC 3339 time: when the event happened, or when a control message was sent.

id.description: Unique message id. For widget.message it is the outbox event id, the same on every redelivery.

hello.description: First message after the handshake: refetch the chat over REST.

heartbeat_interval_ms.description: The server sends heartbeat this often; a widget that hears nothing for twice as long reconnects.

heartbeat.description: Sent every heartbeat_interval_ms so the widget notices a dead connection.

resyncRequired.description: Events may have been missed (the server lost its fan-out link, or the session's contact changed): refetch the chat over REST.

widgetMessage.description: An operator or the bot replied in the visitor's chat: fetch it over REST (GET /widget/messages since the cursor).

widgetTyping.description: Signal: an operator is typing a reply. Show it for at most 6 s; a new message ends it earlier. Ephemeral, never replayed.
